errors.bottomAboveTop: The bottom of a layer must lie deeper than its top.
errors.capBelowSurface: The upper limit must be positive and at least equal to the ultimate resistance at ground level.
errors.equivalentMismatch: Equivalent depths do not match the selected layer correction.
errors.equivalentOverflow: The equivalent-layer calculation exceeds the numerical range.
errors.invalidSpringLayer: Invalid spring layer or number of equivalent layers.
errors.layersUnsorted: Soil layers overlap or are not sorted by depth.
errors.maxElements: At most 200 elements; choose a larger element length.
errors.missingUltimate: Enter the ultimate resistance for layer {{layer}}.
errors.noConvergence: No convergence: check the load, available soil resistance and spring parameters.
errors.noConvergenceFull: No convergence for the full load case.
errors.noConvergenceSteps: No convergence within the maximum number of load steps.
errors.nonlinearNeedsUltimate: The nonlinear spring requires an ultimate resistance.
errors.nonlinearOverflow: Numerical overflow in the nonlinear model.
errors.normalForceOutside: Axial force outside the cross-section resistance.
errors.numericOverflow: Numerical overflow; check units and input.
errors.ownSpringPositive: Custom moduli of subgrade reaction in the settings must be positive.
errors.profileMismatch: Soil profile and beam layers or initial stiffness do not match.
errors.springDisplacement: The spring displacement must be finite.
errors.springOutsideLayer: The spring depth lies outside the selected soil layer.
errors.surchargeModel: Choose a substantiated load model for the surcharge; q is not automatically a net pressure on the pile.
errors.tooMuchRebar: Too much reinforcement for the cross-section.
errors.zeroStrengthLayer: A layer with zero strength cannot represent the ultimate resistance of the layers above.

input.axialHint: The calculation uses N only for the N–M check of the cross-section, not for second-order effects.
input.coverTitle: Distance from the concrete edge to the bar centre
input.eiHint: EI = Ec,eff·Ic + Es·Is + Ea·Ia with Ec,eff = Ec × project factor / (1 + creep). Enter design strengths including material factors.
input.head: Pile head
input.headAssumed: Pile head assumed at NAP 0.00; enter the actual level.
input.k0Hint: k₀ = kh × effective width. Between layers without subgrade reaction the soil provides no support.
input.puHint: pu(z) = min(pu,max; pu,0 + g·z), ultimate resistance per metre of pile.
input.retainingHint: Retaining model: Δp = Ka·q with Ka = tan²(45° − φ/2), line load = Δp × influence width. Only the increase due to q; no strip load or soil movement around a free pile.
input.wallTitle: Effective residual wall thickness after corrosion

inspector.georgiadis: Georgiadis: layer correction via equivalent depth; no separate p-y spring law.
inspector.k0Note: k₀ remains the entered subgrade reaction × effective width.
inspector.linearNote: Linear spring without a limit on p.
inspector.nonlinearNote: Hyperbolic project model, static and monotonic; symmetric resistance, without cyclic hysteresis or degradation.
inspector.pNote: p is the mobilised resistance; the soil reaction on the pile is −p.
inspector.profile: Project profile pu = min(cap, pu,0 + g × z): pu,0 = {{pu0}} kN/m; g = {{g}} kN/m²; cap = {{cap}} kN/m. z used = {{z}} m. These limit values require project-specific substantiation.
inspector.sourceText: k0 = kh × effective width; pu profile = project input
inspector.title: Soil spring · layer {{n}}
